title: Bill of Rights (1689)
key_facts: Act of Parliament establishing limits on the monarchy and rights of Parliament
Codified regular parliaments, free elections, and freedom of speech in Parliament
Prohibited cruel and unusual punishment and excessive bail
causes: Settlement following the Glorious Revolution and deposition of James II
Desire to prevent abuses of royal prerogative
Constitutional thought shaped by Civil War debates and Locke
outcome: Foundation for constitutional monarchy in Britain
Influenced later rights documents (e.g., US Bill of Rights)

figures.name: William III and Mary II
figures.role: Monarchs who accepted the Bill of Rights

impacts: Model for constitutional governance and civil liberties
Inspired Atlantic and global constitutional movements
